name: tama
description: Your own Markdown notes, readable and writable from Claude.
long_description: Tama keeps voice notes and work summaries as Markdown in a git repo you own. This extension lets Claude search those notes, read one, append to them, and record what a session did - so a decision made today is still answerable in six weeks. It talks to a Tama server you already run; nothing is sent anywhere else.

server_url.title: Tama server address
server_url.description: Where your Tama server is reachable from this computer. If Tama runs on this machine, keep the default. If it runs elsewhere, use the address `tama expose` printed - it is dialled from here, not from Anthropic, so a private tailnet address works.

device_token.title: Device token
device_token.description: Run `tama-server connect claude-desktop` where Tama runs and paste what it prints - it gives this field and the address together. On a Docker deployment the command is `tama connect`. Shown once.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search the notes and return the passages that match.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read one note by its path.

tools.name: append_note
tools.description: Write a new note into the vault.

tools.name: record_session
tools.description: Record what this session did in the project's log.

tools.name: today
tools.description: What the user has been working on lately.
